products.title: Products
products.dummyItemsExplainer: OFCP dummy items are generated from the server’s start price, percentage increase, and end price. TECSAFE can address them by itemId. They are normally hidden from search and the product overview; this button shows them in the demo catalog.

product.configuratorConsentRequired: The product configurator requires data exchange with TECSAFE.
product.debugWidgetActive: Debug widget active — the product configurator is replaced by the TECSAFE debug console.

consent.title: Privacy settings
consent.intro: The product configurator on this site is provided by TECSAFE. To use it, product and session data is exchanged with TECSAFE and stored in your browser. Optionally you can allow usage tracking. You can change your choice at any time via "Privacy settings" in the footer.
consent.allowDataExchange: Allow data exchange with TECSAFE (required for the configurator)

v1.label: v1 · recommended
v1.description: Required privacy settings are always enabled. Usage tracking is optional.

v2.label: v2 · legally transparent
v2.description: Choose data exchange with TECSAFE explicitly. Usage tracking is optional.

v3.label: v3 · a lawyer’s friend
v3.description: Choose data exchange with TECSAFE, TECSAFE usage tracking, and the shop’s own usage tracking separately.

consent.allowNativeTracking: Allow the shop’s own usage tracking (optional)
consent.saveError: Your choice could not be saved to your account. Please try again.
consent.privacyPolicyInfo: Check our privacy policy for more info
consent.privacyPolicyPlaceholder: Normally, the privacy policy would open here.

whitelabel.title: Demo Settings
whitelabel.intro: Configure branding and debugger modes for this browser. Use Demo Sharing to store these settings on the server and create a link.

logoError.notImage: The logo must be an image file.
logoError.tooLarge: The logo is too large — the limit is 2 MB.

whitelabel.debugWidget: Widget mode — replace the product configurator with the debug console

share.title: Save on server & share
share.intro: With the shop owner’s secret, your branding and debugger settings can be stored on the server for a limited time. Anyone opening the link gets them applied automatically.

error.disabled: Sharing is not enabled on this server.
error.failed: Saving on the server failed. Please try again.

whitelabel.sdkDebugger: SDK mode — show the SDK debugger overlay
whitelabel.debuggerIntro: Enable each debugger independently. Saving applies the selected modes to the configurator.
